title: HDR 2D viewport (linear RGBA16F) read back and quantized to 8-bit PNG without sRGB encoding
expected_finding: capture_readback holds linear colour from viewport_2d_hdr, and encode_capture writes it to 8-bit PNG pixels without linear_to_srgb, so screenshot midtones are too dark (the window path encodes through its sRGB swapchain format)
